trigger: An active production incident, material service degradation, security event, or customer-impacting data integrity failure requires containment, recovery, or a post-incident follow-up.
exitSignal: Containment or recovery is verified, remaining impact and risk are explicit, root-cause status is honest, and follow-up actions have owners and observable completion criteria.
evidence: Current incident evidence identifies impact, severity, affected scope, owner, and containment or mitigation decision.
Relevant diagnostic and decision evidence was preserved safely, recovery checks were defined and observed, and communications distinguish verified facts from unknowns.
A blameless post-incident record identifies timeline, contributing conditions, root-cause status, and owned corrective actions.
